claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V3.2 — Runtime-Defect Closure post-V4 fresh-run audit. 10-agent parallel audit on commit 5b88522a surfaced 3 runtime defects + 1 deferred shadow-tree issue. D1: belief evidence freshness — multiple write paths to beliefs.jsonl (_record_belief / _apply_diff_to_existing_beliefs / _mark_quarantined_source_beliefs) with only the support path stamping freshness fields. D2: daily-report 'Total governance events' reads from shadow aria-kernel/aria-tools/ tree due to tool_registry.tools_dir CWD-relative fallback. D3: discovery_dirty_tree_skipped governance event missing cycle_id in details. D4 (DEFERRED to V3.3): full tools_dir Tier-1 rewrite + shadow-tree purge (blast radius too large — ~30 callsite migration). Plan ARIA-V3.2 lands Tier-1 unified-writer fix for D1, Tier-2 narrow caller-layer assertion for D2, Tier-3 schema completeness for D3, with 10 invariants total under aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v3_2/.

resolution_summary: Plan ARIA-V3.3 CONVERGED — F-010 umbrella RESOLVED across V3.2 + V3.3 arcs. V3.2 (4 commits + hotfix + reconciliation) closed D1 (Tier-1 unified belief-freshness writer) and D3 (Tier-3 cycle_id schema completeness). V3.3 (2 fix commits + this resolution) closed D4 (Tier-1 tools_dir always-absolute + walk-up resolver + raise on unresolvable — F-010-D4) and D2-POSTMORTEM (Tier-2 defer_reflection kwarg + orchestrator post-drain reflection). V3.2 §2b 'shadow tree' theory for D2 was empirically WRONG (autonomous-loop fresh-run audit on 2026-05-16); the real D2 root cause was reflection ordering, tracked as D2-POSTMORTEM and closed in V3.3. 18 invariants total across v3_2/ (10) + v3_3/ (8). 1669 + 8 = 1677 kernel tests green.
resolution_summary_short: Plan ARIA-V3.3 CONVERGED — F-010 RESOLVED. V3.2 closed D1+D3; V3.3 closed D4 (Tier-1 tools_dir rewrite) + D2-POSTMORTEM (Tier-2 reflection ordering). 18 invariants, 1677 tests green.
v3_3_resolution_summary: Plan ARIA-V3.3 CONVERGED — 2 architectural commits + this F-010 closure. Phase 3.1 (commit 9855116f) Tier-1 tools_dir rewrite: explicit path → ARIA_TOOLS_DIR env → walk-up-to-bound-identity → raise GovernanceError. Every return is absolute; CWD-relative shadow tree class structurally impossible. CLI entry resolved at the boundary so args.tools_dir is always-absolute or None. Pre-existing aria-kernel/aria-tools/ shadow purged. Phase 3.2 (commit b892ef09) Tier-2 defer_reflection kwarg: backward-compatible parameter on run_enterprise_cycle; orchestrator passes True and invokes run_reflection AFTER planner+bridge+worker+auto_merge drainer phases complete. Daily report's 'Total governance events' now matches actual governance.jsonl row count. 8 new invariants under aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v3_3/ covering both Tier-1 paths.

evidences.summary: D1 ROOT CAUSE — three independent writers to beliefs.jsonl; only _record_belief stamps verified_at + base_commit_sha. _apply_diff_to_existing_beliefs (diff-decay) + _mark_quarantined_source_beliefs (quarantine) append rows without refreshing freshness.

D2 ROOT CAUSE — tools_dir() default fallback Path('aria-tools') is CWD-relative. When invoked from aria-kernel/ subdir, creates SHADOW aria-kernel/aria-tools/ tree. Reflection's _gate_activity_summary then reads the shadow ledger (8 stale rows) instead of canonical aria-tools/governance.jsonl (29 fresh rows).
D3 ROOT CAUSE — append_tools_governance call for 'discovery_dirty_tree_skipped' omits cycle_id in details dict, despite cycle_id being in function scope and every sibling event including it.

Plan ARIA-V3.2 master plan — 6-agent audit (3 Explore + 3 Plan), 4 commits planned (D3 -> D2 -> D1 -> holistic), 10 invariants under aria-kernel/tests/invariants/v3_2/, F-010-D4 named-deferral to V3.3.

subfindings.title: Full tools_dir Tier-1 rewrite + shadow-tree purge
subfindings.resolution_note: Plan ARIA-V3.3 Phase 3.1 (Fix-A) Tier-1 architectural rewrite. tools_dir resolution order: explicit path → ARIA_TOOLS_DIR env → walk-up-to-bound-identity → raise GovernanceError('tools_root_unresolvable'). Every successful return is absolute; CWD-relative interpretation structurally impossible. CLI entry consumes the same funnel so args.tools_dir is always-absolute or None. migrate-tools-bootstrap added to _TOOLS_DIR_REQUIRED_COMMANDS so destructive bootstrap fails fast with a clear remediation message. Pre-existing aria-kernel/aria-tools/ shadow purged in the same commit. 5 invariants I-V3.3-01..04, 08 pin the contract.
